title: Build a PHP Laravel Filament + Livewire order-refund resource preserving server authority, authorization, and accessible feedback

contextSnapshot.surface: Operations refund management table and action modal in a Laravel Filament panel
contextSnapshot.platform: PHP 8.3 / Laravel 11 + Filament v3 + Livewire + Blade
constraints: preserve Laravel/Filament idioms rather than replacing with a React SPA
accessible focus return and aria-live announcements on Livewire updates

prompt: Extend our existing Laravel 11 + Filament v3 admin panel with an Order Refund queue and partial-refund modal action that enforces RefundPolicy authorization, shows inline server validation errors, handles Livewire loading states, and stays usable at 390px.
forbiddenBehaviors: proposes rewriting the Filament resource in React or Inertia when Laravel + Filament is the brownfield stack
hides unauthorized actions only via CSS instead of enforcing Laravel Policy / Action::authorize()
omits wire:loading / disabled guards on destructive refund submission, allowing duplicate refunds on double click
removes focus outlines or drops keyboard focus after closing a Livewire/Filament modal

rubricDimensions.pass: uses Filament Table/Form/Action schemas, server-side Policy authorization, wire:loading disable/feedback states, and Blade/Livewire URL query persistence for filters
rubricDimensions.fail: imports a redundant JS SPA framework or bypasses Filament schemas with raw brittle inline JS

rubricDimensions.pass: preserves entered refund amounts on validation failure, announces errors programmatically, prevents duplicate submits, and ensures table actions remain reachable at 390px
rubricDimensions.fail: resets form fields on error or clips modal actions on narrow screens

rubricDimensions.pass: distinguishes PHPUnit/Pest Livewire tests (static/behavioral) from rendered browser checks at 390/768/1440px
rubricDimensions.fail: claims responsive visual quality from php artisan test alone

negativeControls.name: pest test pass only
negativeControls.mustNot: claim 390px mobile modal layout and focus-ring visibility are rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: suggests bolting on a custom React widget, omits double-submit wire:loading guards, and ignores narrow-screen table/modal ergonomics
baseline.withSkill: builds an idiomatic Laravel Filament + Livewire resource with Policy enforcement, idempotent submit feedback, accessible validation, and honest evidence labels
